reason: Tried to break it on the translator, which was the obvious crack, and it held. The Columbia Asia for Educators PDF is set in subset Palatino fonts with a shifted encoding, so I decompressed the page content streams, parsed the ToUnicode CMap in object 35, and decoded the body myself rather than accept the verifier's transcription. The decoded opening paragraph reads: “During the reign-period T'ai yuan [326-97] of the Chin dynasty there lived in Wu-ling a certain fisherman. One day, as he followed the course of a stream, he became unconscious of the distance he had travelled. All at once he came upon a grove of blossoming peach trees which lined either bank for hundreds of paces.” The proposed quotation matches word for word and point for point, including the British travelled, and it is indeed the second and third sentences. The attack I expected to land was that Cyril Birch is named on the title page as EDITOR of the Anthology, not as translator of this piece, and the credit line only says edited by Cyril Birch. It fails: the decoded page 2 ends the document with the bracketed line “[Translated by Cyril Birch]”, so Birch translated it himself and trans. Cyril Birch, 1965 is correct. Credit line confirmed as Anthology of Chinese Literature, Volume I: From Early Times to the Fourteenth Century, edited by Cyril Birch (New York: Grove Press, 1965), 167-168, reproduced with the publisher's permission, so the text is a licensed reprint and not a web paraphrase. shipped.js: not shipped, nothing near, Tao Yuanming 0 of 3, not banned, and no second Tao Yuanming in April. In scope: a fifth-century prose tale, translation 1965, no scripture, nothing needing a warning. On theme exactly: a man following a stream until he loses count of the distance is the Way and the renewal in one image. Source line leads with the name, no dash, no straight quote, ends in a full stop, 92 characters. One judgement call I looked at and let stand: Columbia's own introduction calls the piece an essay, so Essay was arguable, but the work is an invented narrative with characters and a plot, so Fiction is the better reading of the form and the fiction-essay lane already carries four Essay entries.
